item.description: The _normalize_path_segments function in URL class does not correctly handle all edge cases for path normalization, particularly with sequences of dots and special Unicode characters. Tests like test_normalize_path are failing because the current implementation doesn't properly handle all combinations of dots in paths.
item.contract: Update the _normalize_path_segments function to correctly handle all dot sequences according to RFC 3986 specifications. The function should properly process sequences like ".", "..", and combinations of them, including in Unicode paths. It should correctly resolve paths like "../path/to" to "path/to" and handle special cases like "/foo/../../../ton" to "/ton".
item.acceptance: Tests in test_normalize_path.py should pass for all test cases including those with Unicode characters and complex dot sequences.

item.description: Host parsing and validation logic in URL class has issues with certain edge cases involving dots in hostnames and malformed URLs. The host parsing tests are failing because the URL constructor and host validation functions don't correctly handle special hostnames like "example.com." or malformed hostnames with trailing dots.
item.contract: Fix the host parsing and validation logic to properly handle edge cases with dots in hostnames, including trailing dots, internationalized domains, and special character combinations. The host validation should properly accept valid hostnames with dots and reject invalid ones.
item.acceptance: Tests in test_url.py that are failing with host_port_subcomponent should pass, particularly those involving hostnames with dots like "example.com." and "xn--gnter-4ya.com".

item.description: Cache configuration functions have incorrect parameter handling. The cache_configure function is failing tests because it's not properly handling deprecated parameters and parameter validation.
item.contract: Update the cache_configure function to properly handle deprecated parameters (ip_address_size and host_validate_size) and ensure backward compatibility while correctly processing new parameter values. The function should handle None values correctly and emit deprecation warnings for deprecated parameters.
item.acceptance: Tests in test_cache.py that are failing at setup stage should pass, including test_cache_configure_None_including_deprecated, test_cache_configure_None_only_deprecated, and test_cache_configure_waring.
